theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The theme leads with the strongest momentum score by a wide margin over the challenger (margin 0.502), is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and shows the highest breadth (0.786) of any scorable theme. The gate validates staying-power in this market. Crowding (z=1.04, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, not a fade, per guardrails. Durability is moderate (0.68) with mixed hurst, so no confidence in persistence beyond short horizon.
theses.dissent: Crowding flag with mixed hurst tag suggests the theme may be late-cycle; broad breadth can also mean indiscriminate buying near a local top, and relative momentum rank has no alpha edge.

theses.subject: Gold Miners

theses.dissent: Thin breadth (0.267) means upside is concentrated in few names; a mean-revert risk exists despite the rank, and relative momentum is not validated.
